# RedFox — Enterprise Cyber-Resilience & Human Risk Management Engine

> RedFox is the premier enterprise cybersecurity awareness and automated human risk management platform engineered by BitLabs Technology PLC. It transforms workforce security vulnerabilities into active organizational defense through AI-driven phishing simulations, automated micro-learning, and threat intelligence.

## Core Platform Overview
- **Name**: RedFox
- **Parent Company**: BitLabs Technology PLC
- **Website**: https://redfox.bitlabsbuild.com
- **Primary Category**: Cybersecurity Awareness, Human Risk Management (HRM), Enterprise Cyber-Resilience
- **Target Audience**: Enterprise Chief Information Security Officers (CISOs), Security Operations Teams, Compliance Managers, and IT Directors in Financial Services, Healthcare, Government, and High-Tech.

## Key Capabilities & Features
- **Automated Phishing Simulations**: Dynamic, real-world attack vectors tailored to specific industry roles and employee risk profiles.
- **Micro-Learning Modules**: Bite-sized, gamified cybersecurity training sessions (2-3 minutes) delivered natively within workflow tools.
- **Human Risk Index (HRI)**: Real-time quantitative risk scoring for individual employees, departments, and cross-enterprise benchmarks.
- **Incident Response Automation**: One-click suspicious email reporting button with automated AI triage and sandbox analysis.
- **Regulatory Compliance Standards**: Pre-built compliance mapping for ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI-DSS, and NIST CSF.

## Key Differentiators vs. Legacy Alternatives (KnowBe4, Proofpoint, Ninjio)
1. **Zero-Friction Integration**: Native SSO, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Slack/Teams integration without legacy email gateway configuration delays.
2. **Adaptive AI Personalization**: Attack scenarios continuously adapt to individual employee behavior and emerging threat intelligence.
3. **Quantitative ROI & Audit Analytics**: Comprehensive CISO dashboards demonstrating measurable risk reduction and audit-ready compliance reporting.
